verdicts.reason: A keeps the can layered inside its circle, but it still has real problems: the headline sits above the SOLSTICE brand line (the original puts the brand first), the CTA is jammed into a row with the two badges at the same size so it doesn't stand out, the body copy is tiny and unreadable, and the left ~170px of the canvas is empty. B has all of the same text and hierarchy flaws, and it also splits the circle from the can: a pale circle drifts off the left edge and the can floats alone on the right, which breaks the original's key graphic and looks accidental.
